items.title: Expose boolean types in `cuda.compute` correctly
items.body:
Currently, boolean types aren't plugged in to `cuda.compute`, leading to errors like the following:

```python
import cupy as cp
import numpy as np

import cuda.compute
from cuda.compute import OpKind

# Prepare the input and output arrays.
h_init = np.array([False])
d_input = cp.array([True, False, True])
d_output = cp.empty_like(d_input, shape=(1,))

# Perform the reduction.
cuda.compute.reduce_into(d_input, d_output, OpKind.MAXIMUM, len(d_input), h_init)

# Verify the result.
print(d_output.get())
```
